title: Profile
subtitle: Your account, your password and the devices signed in to it.

general.title: Account details
general.description: How you appear in records and how your experiment codes begin.
general.usernameHelp: Shown next to everything you record. Changing it is itself recorded.
general.prefixHelp: 2–4 letters used for new experiment codes (like {example}1).
general.currentPasswordHelp: Needed to confirm it is you.
general.unchanged: Nothing changed: your details are already up to date.
general.needCurrent: Enter your current password to save changes.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out of every other device.
password.rules: At least {min} characters, and it must not contain your username.
password.saved: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.needCurrent: Enter your current password to change it.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.description: A code from an authenticator app protects your account even if your password is stolen.
twoStep.requiredForRole: Your role requires it, so it cannot be turned off.
twoStep.recoveryLeft: {count, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}
twoStep.recoveryHelp: Recovery codes are single-use. Keep them somewhere safe, apart from your password.
twoStep.newCodesHelp: Enter a current code to replace all recovery codes. The old ones stop working.
twoStep.newCodesDone: Your new recovery codes. They are shown only now.
twoStep.turnOffHelp: Confirm with your password and a current code.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account. End any you do not recognise.
sessions.endOthersDone: {count, plural, one {# other session ended.} other {# other sessions ended.}}
sessions.onlyThis: This is the only device signed in.
